item.title: When Will Voters On The Isle Of Wight Head To The Polls?
item.description: After a week of political reshuffling, residents across the Isle of Wight are asking the same question — when are the next local elections?

item.title: Cowes Teen Lights Up Highfield Road For Charity
item.description: A Cowes youngster is once again bringing festive sparkle to his neighbourhood with a spectacular Christmas lights display — all in aid of a local marching band.

item.title: Top Five Retro Christmas Songs You Pretended to Hate but Secretly Loved
item.description: We’ve all done it. Rolled our eyes. Scoffed. Said things like, “Ugh, this again?” But deep down — deep, deep down — we knew the truth: these retro Christmas songs absolutely slapped, and we belted them out the moment no one was around. item.title: Top Five Christmas Party Foods from the ’80s/’90s That Have Vanished
item.description: Once upon a time, Christmas parties weren’t all grazing boards, miniature brioche sliders, and things sprinkled with rosemary “for the aesthetic.” No — in the ’80s and ’90s, our festive buffets were an unapologetic collage of beige, jelly-based experimentation, and supermarket madness. Some of these snacks were iconic. Some were deeply questionable. And some simply evaporated from the shelves when society collectively realised they probably shouldn’t exist. item.title: A Night Of Sixties Magic At Dimbola As ‘Jimi And Friends’ Rock Freshwater
item.description: The night featured a special appearance from Dick Taylor, widely regarded as the Island’s godfather of rock ’n’ roll.

item.title: Islanders Invited To Help Shape Future Of Local Food Growing
item.description: Island residents are being encouraged to have their say on the future of community food growing through a new survey launched this week.

item.title: Wroxall Roadworks Ahead Of Schedule As Temporary Reopening Announced
item.description: Works to rebuild and resurface the main road through Wroxall are running slightly ahead of schedule, with the route set to reopen tomorrow evening.

item.title: Sadie, 13, Becomes First Female Winner Of Wightlink’s Responsible Angler Award
item.description: A 13-year-old student from The Bay School has made history by becoming the first female recipient of the Wightlink Award for Most Responsible Angler.

item.title: Man Arrested After Late-Night Crash In Ryde
item.description: Police have arrested a 32-year-old man following a collision in Ryde that left three vehicles damaged on Friday.

item.title: Police Appeal For Witnesses After Woman Assaulted In Binstead
item.description: A 32-year-old man from Ryde has been arrested on suspicion of intentional strangulation and common assault.
